title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is buzzing with mergers, funding rounds, and strategic partnerships as companies scramble to position themselves ahead of an anticipated IPO wave. Meanwhile, government budgets are tightening, but the appetite for innovation remains strong, particularly in defense tech and satellite capabilities.

themes.title: Mergers and Acquisitions Heat Up
themes.body: MDA Space's acquisition of Blue Canyon Technologies underscores the ongoing trend of consolidation as companies seek to bolster their market positions. With more players eyeing strategic buys, expect the pace of M&A to quicken as firms race to scale.

themes.title: Funding Rounds Fuel Growth
themes.body: ElevationSpace's recent $40 million Series B funding round is a testament to the growing investor confidence in space ventures. As private equity firms and venture capitalists ramp up their stakes, the capital flow into the sector shows no signs of slowing.

themes.title: Government Budgets and Defense Tech
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup adding $1.4 billion to space resilience highlights the government's commitment to fortifying its space capabilities. As defense contractors pivot towards innovative solutions, the demand for advanced technologies is likely to surge.

themes.title: Emerging LEO Constellations
themes.body: India's Jio is laying the groundwork for a sovereign LEO constellation, signaling a significant move in the global satellite landscape. This initiative could reshape competitive dynamics, particularly as nations seek to establish their own space infrastructures.
